subject: Voice-first playbook replaces the three-emotion conversation
body: Supersede D-onboarding-003 with the playbook in docs/hackathon/elicitation-playbook.md (one person-chosen state, sections 1 to 4). Voice-first: revisit D-onboarding-002 so speech in and out is the primary surface, with transcript, typed and scripted fallbacks. Keep the safety pre-check (D-onboarding-005) and add the mild-contrast and break-state rules from the playbook.
